name: Tírvia (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with a yellow twelve-pointed star formed of two superimposed six-pointed stars, bearing a white crescent.
history: The flag of Tírvia is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light blue, with a yellow six-pointed star of 5/6 of the height of the cloth at the centre, superimposed on another of the same dimensions rotated 90°; the town council commissioned several proposals for a new flag, approved initially by the council on 5 October 2023 and by the Directorate-General for Local Administration on 12 August 2024.

features.role: two six-pointed stars superimposed and rotated to form twelve points
